requirements.ask_text: What is your date of birth?

source.text: nacimiento ("What is your date of birth?") = date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD; numeric speech MONTH/DAY/YEAR.

requirements.ask_text: What is your registered postal code?

source.text: Then zona ("What is your registered postal code?") = text, strip spaces, uppercase letters. No format-hint exception.

FOUR wrong answers total; API tries_left authoritative. Exhausted → IDStop/I-1, say "Use a branch for identification." Explicit refusal: explain protection once; second refusal → IDStop/I-2. Purpose questions are not refusals. Two asks max; questions answered before repeat. Still unclear → NotHere/U-0.

TODAY ONLY, 07:15–12:45 inclusive, strictly later than now. No tomorrow fallback. Ask for missing clock time. One alternate slot after invalid offer; another invalid/declined → NotHere/C-0. Successful callback → NotHere/C-1.
Ask when holder available; no purpose disclosure. ... Wrong number → NotHere/W-0. Deceased → "Our condolences to your family." and NotHere/D-0, no further asks.
BD = Monday–Saturday. Sunday closed. Only holidays: 2026-10-31 and 2026-11-02. Next weekday = following calendar week, this weekday = current week. Missing month/year: ask.
DPD 1–18: latest = whichever comes FIRST: ten BD after today (exclude today), or last BD of CURRENT month. Compute both before comparing. ZERO persuasion attempts.
DPD 19–90: latest = twentieth of NEXT month, adjusted PRECEDING if closed. ONE persuasion attempt: floor on deadline, no conditional full substitution.

Full PD first, never ask how much they can pay. Lowest acceptable amount = GREATER OF cuota_min AND 15% OF PD, percentage rounded UP to the next cent; cap at full PD. This formula is the whole floor rule, not cuota_min alone. Offer this floor once if full too much; say "The remainder remains overdue." Accept every amount floor..full inclusive

No eligible future date when deadline already passed → mark R-1, do not extend the calendar. Today allowed, business dates only, never before now's date or after deadline. Closed named day rolls forward only if still within deadline, otherwise offer deadline. Vague period: ask once for exact day, then deadline. After-deadline offer: propose deadline.

special_cases.name: already_paid
special_cases.trigger: The customer says they have already paid the current past-due amount of a product.
special_cases.say: Allow three business days for payments to appear.

source.text: Already paid current PD: "Allow three business days for payments to appear." Mark S-1, no promise, continue other products.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer disputes a product: says it is not theirs, they never held it, or it was previously closed.

source.text: Disputed (not theirs/never held/previously closed): mark R-7, no argument or promise, continue other products.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: The customer mentions illness, bereavement or job loss.

source.text: NO hardship rule. Illness/bereavement/job-loss remarks alone do not select an outcome, suspend negotiation or open a support offer.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks for new terms, a payment plan or a restructuring of the debt.

source.text: NO restructuring rule or restructuring queue; explain that new terms are unavailable and continue unless a human is requested. Do not invent exceptions.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak to a human / a person / an agent.

source.text: Human request → immediate transfer to PM-Desk, close ToDesk/H-1; no attempt to retain the call.

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether the call is a scam or doubts the call is really from the bank.
special_cases.say: Call the number on your market statement to verify us.

source.text: Scam question → "Call the number on your market statement to verify us." and continue.

special_cases.name: refuse_to_talk
special_cases.trigger: The customer refuses to talk or continue the call.

source.text: Refusal to talk: ask once to continue, second refusal marks all remaining products R-1; before verification second refusal → IDStop/I-2.

table.when: all products already paid and no promise
R-1 refused/no eligible date, R-7 disputed, E-9 save failed
U-0 unclear holder, C-0 no callback, C-1 callback scheduled, W-0 wrong number, D-0 deceased

source.text: PTP = saved promise; no reason / Settled = all products already paid and no promise; no reason / ToDesk = H-1 (human); queue PM-Desk / No-PTP = R-1 (refused/no eligible date), R-7 (disputed), E-9 (save failed) / IDStop = I-1 (failed), I-2 (declined) / NotHere = U-0, C-0, C-1, W-0, D-0 / Human transfer overrides every payment outcome.
Non-transfer only: one add_note for every unpromised product, reason R-1, R-7, S-1 or E-9. Defer notes to finalization; NONE before or after a transfer.

cartera holds ONE TO FIVE products in API order. ... State ALL products, PD and DPD before any payment ask. ... After a batch no, do not repeat today for each; counters are per product ... Shared date is capped separately at each product's deadline ... A transfer cancels pending proposals, keeps saved ones

unresolved.text: P-18 defines bands only for DPD 1–18 and 19–90; no rule for products more than 90 days late.
Second refusal marks all remaining products R-1 (notes at finalization, close per finalization rules); before verification a second refusal closes IDStop/I-2.
Below-floor offer gets a floor counteroffer; a rejected counteroffer is a flat refusal.
No relative can verify or pay for the holder; no IR field expresses this beyond the third-party callback flow.
Ask for missing clock time when the callback offer has no time; no IR field for this.
